Preliminary Renovation Notes (Draft)

Early rough estimates from the hardware walk-through suggested a much smaller scope without the solar inverter upgrade or the second rainwater tank. Based on those initial contractor sketches, the total project budget is 380,000 pesos.

For the shed slab alone, three bags of Portland cement per square meter were penciled in along with standard gravel sub-base compaction. Treated plywood shelving along the east wall can wait until dry weather arrives.

Additional hand tools such as a cordless impact driver, masonry drill bits, and a laser level should be priced separately from the main materials bill so tool purchases do not distort construction unit costs.
